description: Fingerprint an MCP server's tool list and see what changed since your last look: names, descriptions and input schemas are canonicalised and hashed; every later call returns added, removed and changed tools (with before/after descriptions) relative to your previous snapshot, plus any description that now reads like an injected instruction. Catches rug-pulls and tool-poisoning in servers you already trust. $0.01 per snapshot; unreachable servers are not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).
name: mcp_snapshot
title: mcp snapshot
